title: Orsen and the Ghost
author: Zephyrine Voss
blurb: Yara Yarrow, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
